classes.method: Syntetos-Boylan ADI/CV2 on each series' REAL history (pre-introduction days excluded) up to the last SELECTION origin

ensemble_l2.rule: wave 30: the same screen on the per-origin pooled WRMSSE (zero-scale units excluded per origin) — best three of the pool ranked by mean + 1.0 x population std over the 8 selection origins, weights simplex-grid-fit minimising the same screen (step 0.05, selection origins only, ties -> first grid point); same bitwise-identity dedup as the WAPE blend — wave 28 comparison/demo material

ensemble.rule: wave 30: best three of the pool by the stability screen — mean + 1.0 x population std of the per-origin pooled WAPE over the 8 selection origins; weights simplex-grid-fit (step 0.05, selection origins only, ties -> first grid point) minimising the same screen of the blend's per-origin WAPE, computed exactly from the forecast-level convex combination; pool members whose selection forecasts are bitwise identical to an admitted member are skipped (wave 28 dedup — a duplicate carries no new information and would only displace a diverse member). Replaces the wave-25..29 pooled-metric rule, whose wave-29 blend overfit selection (+0.0048 test WAPE vs wave 28)

wrmsse_champion.note: best pooled test WRMSSE among the committed candidates; the WAPE-primary headline stays convex_ensemble (wave 28)

weekly_rolling.method: next_week: pooled WAPE over h=1..7 of ALL origins (each origin's first-week forecast = one deployed weekly forecast; the 8 selection origins are included, so this is the rolling weekly SERVICE number, not a held-out estimate — the held-out estimate stays the 28-day test block below). weekly_blocks: pooled WAPE per 7-day block (wk1 h1-7 .. wk4 h22-28) over the 2 scored-once test origins; weekly_block_demand holds the per-block Σ actual (turning WAPE gaps into absolute-error reductions).
